claims.claim: Proposed outperforms the dense baseline at every measured cutoff.
claims.result: all 9 metric-cutoff combinations favour Proposed; every 95% CI excludes zero
claims.limitation: automated relevance labels; pool depth 20
claims.allowed_wording: Proposed outperformed the dense baseline at every measured cutoff under automated pooled relevance judgements.
claims.prohibited_wording: Any phrasing implying human-validated relevance labels.

claims.claim: Proposed ranks definitional evidence earlier than DOS-RAG.
claims.limitation: ranking claim only; does not extend to total relevant material retrieved
claims.allowed_wording: Proposed placed relevant and definitional passages earlier in the ranking than DOS-RAG at k=5 and k=10, under automated pooled relevance judgements.
claims.prohibited_wording: Proposed retrieves more relevant evidence than DOS-RAG overall.

claims.claim: Proposed and DOS-RAG show no material separation at k=10.
claims.limitation: NO pre-registered retrieval equivalence margin exists
claims.allowed_wording: P@10 and R@10 showed no material separation; the paired intervals contain zero.
claims.prohibited_wording: statistically equivalent; equivalent.

claims.claim: DOS-RAG recovers more relevant material by rank 20.
claims.result: R@20 -0.1332; P@20 -0.1321 (favouring DOS-RAG)
claims.limitation: co-occurs with a larger native retrieval budget
claims.allowed_wording: DOS-RAG recovered more relevant material by rank 20, in the configuration with the larger native retrieval budget.
claims.prohibited_wording: This is caused by the retrieval budget.

claims.claim: Pooled relevance labels are automated, not human gold.
claims.result: produced by the frozen Selene judge; 1751 DEFINITIONAL / 2505 RELATED / 3990 NOT_RELEVANT
claims.limitation: all retrieval conclusions inherit evaluator-validity risk
claims.allowed_wording: under automated pooled relevance judgements
claims.prohibited_wording: human gold qrels; gold-standard relevance labels.

claims.claim: The pool is the top-20 union over four distinct retrieval configurations.
claims.result: seven evaluated arms corresponding to four distinct evidence configurations
claims.limitation: relevant passages ranked below 20 by every configuration are unjudged and treated non-relevant
claims.allowed_wording: union of top-20 results from seven evaluated arms, corresponding to four distinct retrieval configurations
claims.prohibited_wording: seven diverse retrieval runs; BaseDense contributed 123 passages to the pool.

claims.claim: The groundedness arm ordering is instrument-sensitive.
claims.result: raw 0.7176; Gwet AC1 0.6076; Spearman rho +0.4286
claims.limitation: construct difference between a support rubric and strict entailment
claims.allowed_wording: The full seven-arm groundedness ordering was instrument-sensitive; only the endpoints reproduced.
claims.prohibited_wording: an objective groundedness ranking; MiniCheck proves Selene wrong.

claims.claim: Gemma >= Qwen > DeepSeek in mathematics and data-mining under both instruments.
claims.result: ordering stable in 2 of 3 domains; sociology instrument-sensitive
claims.validation: no human labels for these domains
claims.limitation: sociology ordering does not reproduce
claims.allowed_wording: Both instruments place DeepSeek below Gemma and Qwen in mathematics and data-mining, while the sociology result is instrument-sensitive.
claims.prohibited_wording: DeepSeek is a definitively weaker drafter.

claims.claim: The drafter is structurally replaceable behind a common contract.
claims.result: single generic ollama_generate call; ZERO conditionals on model identity; model is a CLI arg with env default; think:False applied unconditionally; common output contract across all three drafters
claims.test: static code audit + artifact contract check
claims.validation: static audit; cannot catch semantics expressed without model vocabulary
claims.limitation: only the named models were exercised
claims.allowed_wording: The drafting layer is model-agnostic by architecture: the drafter is replaceable behind a common input/output contract, and no model-family-specific logic is required by the surrounding KC-generation pipeline.
claims.prohibited_wording: Any LLM will work.

claims.claim: Three model families executed the same frozen drafting contract.
claims.result: Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma4-31B, DeepSeek-R1-32B all parsed by one extraction contract, no per-model handling
claims.limitation: a model unable to honour the JSON contract would fail; one did until think:False was added uniformly
claims.allowed_wording: The common drafting interface was exercised without architectural modification using Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma4-31B, and DeepSeek-R1-32B.
claims.prohibited_wording: Any LLM will work as the drafter.

claims.claim: Output quality is invariant to drafter choice.
claims.result: Qwen==Gemma in 3/3 domains under the primary instrument but 1/3 under the verifier; 5 of 9 comparisons agree
claims.limitation: NOT required by model-agnosticism; evaluator- and margin-dependent
claims.allowed_wording: Substituting the drafter can change output quality; architectural portability should not be interpreted as performance invariance. The ablation shows that model choice remains consequential even in a model-agnostic architecture.
claims.prohibited_wording: Treating this as evidence against the architectural claim.

claims.claim: Subject matter enters through corpus and curriculum, not pipeline semantics.
claims.result: D-1..D-7 remediated 2026-08-17, AST-verified, one docstring example remains; evaluated packets confirm post-remediation code: zero semantic-misbinding drops, data-mining domain-specific drops ~66 -> 15, generic math-damage detector fires in all three domains (1/2/7) with mathematics highest
claims.validation: static audit cannot catch semantics expressed without subject vocabulary
claims.limitation: compound_sibling_ownership fires 8x in data-mining and 0x elsewhere - data-driven asymmetry from curriculum shape, not hardcoding
claims.allowed_wording: The KC-generation architecture is domain-agnostic: the pipeline consumes a domain corpus and curriculum representation as inputs, while retrieval, evidence construction, support determination, drafting, provenance, and review operate through domain-independent contracts. Domain knowledge enters through the corpus and curriculum rather than through domain-specific implementation logic.
claims.prohibited_wording: The pipeline has been proven to work equally well in every domain.

claims.claim: One architecture was applied to three subject domains without domain-specific variants.
claims.result: 379 KCs across three domains through identical pipeline contracts
claims.limitation: requires an informative corpus, a curriculum/hierarchy, a convertible source representation, and a compatible drafter - these are inputs, not hardcoded semantics
claims.allowed_wording: The same architecture was exercised on Data Mining, Mathematics, and Sociology without introducing domain-specific pipeline variants.
claims.prohibited_wording: The pipeline works equally well in every domain.

claims.claim: Quality is invariant across subject domains.
claims.result: data-mining and sociology within margin for in-scope drafters under the primary instrument; mathematics outside for every drafter
claims.validation: domain pairs not re-tested on the second instrument
claims.limitation: NOT required by domain-agnosticism
claims.allowed_wording: Performance varied by domain, with Mathematics more difficult under the measured groundedness criterion. The architecture transferred across all three tested domains, while performance remained domain-sensitive.
claims.prohibited_wording: Treating the mathematics result as refuting architectural domain-agnosticism.

claims.claim: Proposed abstained on all corpus-unsupported KCs where DOS-RAG drafted.
claims.result: Proposed 7/7 refused; DOS-RAG drafted on 5/7
claims.validation: Round-2 seed-blind reconstruction, 30 fresh units, blinded order-randomised comparison (Selene-1-Llama-3.3-70B). Round 1 superseded: 22-word median entries and a protocol violation on the unsupported units.
claims.limitation: the support-boundary labels themselves are the contested quantity
claims.allowed_wording: Under the expert reference standard, Proposed abstained on all seven KCs labelled corpus-unsupported, whereas DOS-RAG drafted on five. A seed-blind reconstruction (round 2) independently reached the same no-corpus-support conclusion on two of the three it sampled, recorded partial support on the third, and judged a fourth unit unsupported that the reference had written up. Two of seven labels are therefore independently corroborated, two contested, three untested: partially corroborated, not established.
claims.prohibited_wording: Proposed caught all seven unsupported concepts (as a settled safety result).

claims.claim: No arm produced a description from an empty evidence set.
claims.limitation: a property of the harness contract, not of one pipeline
claims.allowed_wording: No arm produced a description from an empty evidence set.
claims.prohibited_wording: attributing this to the Proposed architecture specifically.

claims.claim: Seed-blind audit found no distortion or unsupported assertion among comparable references.
claims.population: 27 comparable KCs of a 30-KC stratified sample
claims.result: 0 material semantic difference; 0 seeded-extra-unsupported; 18/27 equivalent or both-valid
claims.validation: reviewer is human, comparison is automated
claims.limitation: tested distortion and unsupported assertion only; did NOT test omission, content-selection shaping, or provenance error; support-boundary DISAGREED
claims.allowed_wording: The seed-blind audit found no semantic distortion or unsupported assertions among comparable substantive references, but exposed residual disagreement over the corpus-support boundary.
claims.prohibited_wording: The seed issue was eliminated; the reference was proven unbiased; settled.

claims.claim: Graded completeness met the pre-registered agreement thresholds under LOO calibration.
claims.validation: DEVELOPMENT calibration: the same labels informed metric adoption
claims.limitation: not an independent held-out external qualification set
claims.allowed_wording: The graded completeness score met the preregistered agreement thresholds under leave-one-out calibration on the available 36 human-labelled development cases. Because these labels also contributed to development and adoption of the replacement metric, this is cross-validated development calibration rather than independent external qualification.
claims.prohibited_wording: The judge is qualified; the qualification gate passes.

claims.claim: Judge validation status is criterion-specific.
claims.result: binary completeness FAILED; graded completeness met dev-calibration gates; M1/M2/TARGET/M4A INSUFFICIENT_VALIDATION_SUPPORT
claims.limitation: minority-class support inadequate for M1/M2/TARGET; M4A has zero labels
claims.allowed_wording: criterion-specific status as tabulated
claims.prohibited_wording: collapsing INSUFFICIENT_VALIDATION_SUPPORT into PASSED or FAILED; a single blanket judge status.

claims.claim: An independent entailment verifier was run as an instrument-sensitivity analysis.
claims.result: run and reported
claims.limitation: different construct: strict entailment vs support rubric
claims.allowed_wording: An independent entailment verifier was run as an instrument-sensitivity analysis. It measures reliability and construct sensitivity rather than human validity.
claims.prohibited_wording: Second judge not run; MiniCheck establishes human truth.

claims.claim: A rerun of the claim-decomposition and judging stages reproduced 99.83% of matched decisions.
claims.result: 0.9983; support-rate drift -0.0001; max arm drift 0.0027; ordering rho +0.9643
claims.limitation: 15 drafts excluded where re-decomposition changed the claim count; covers evaluation stages only
claims.allowed_wording: A full rerun of the claim-decomposition and judging stages reproduced 99.83% of matched per-claim decisions.
claims.prohibited_wording: The pipeline reproduces itself at 99.83%; end-to-end KC-generation reproducibility.

claims.claim: Reference-content recovery degrades severely as the passage set grows.
claims.limitation: measured for this model and configuration only
claims.allowed_wording: Selene-based reference-content recovery in our evaluation configuration exhibited severe serial-position sensitivity as the passage set grew.
claims.prohibited_wording: LLM judges are serial-position sensitive (as a universal).

claims.claim: Serving configuration affected judge reproducibility.
claims.result: 1/144 changed under default concurrency; 0/144 with batch-invariant kernels
claims.limitation: one model, one server configuration
claims.allowed_wording: In our Selene/vLLM configuration, concurrent serving changed a judgment despite temperature-zero decoding, while batch-invariant kernels eliminated the observed discrepancy.
claims.prohibited_wording: Batch-invariant serving is required for reproducible LLM judging.

claims.claim: Automated editorial triage neither discriminates nor validates.
claims.result: 97.2-99.3% in top two categories; UNUSABLE never used; exact agreement 0.462
claims.limitation: do not use as a quality metric
claims.allowed_wording: Automated editorial triage failed to discriminate between arms and agreed with expert codes only 0.462 exactly.
claims.prohibited_wording: using triage output as a quality ranking.

claims.claim: About four in five seed drafts needed no more than local editing.
claims.result: ACCEPT 117, MINOR 10, MAJOR 15, REPLACE 10, corpus-gap 7; 127/159 = 79.9%
claims.limitation: seed arm only; corpus-gap count inherits the pending support-boundary status
claims.allowed_wording: Approximately four in five seed drafts required no more than local human editing under the adjudicated reference-construction process.
claims.prohibited_wording: cross-model accuracy; a quality comparison between arms.

claims.claim: The reference library carries an inter-rater agreement statistic.
claims.metric: raw agreement / Gwet AC1 on edit action
claims.result: No second human reviewer performed the curation task. No agreement statistic exists.
claims.prohibited_wording: Any claim of two reviewers, 129/159 agreement, 81.13%, adjudication splits, or human-to-human reliability for the reference library.
claims.allowed_wording: One expert reviewer curated all 159 units. Because the curation was a single-reviewer task, no inter-rater agreement statistic is available and none is reported. The independent check is the seed-blind reconstruction.
claims.limitation: Single-annotator reference; interpretive latitude is unbounded by design.
claims.validation: Artifact audit 2026-09-02: reviewer_b/ empty; 117 rows carry generated boilerplate.
